rows.evidence: java.lang.AssertionError: proxy.md thread model says maxWorkers (2 here) bounds the threads a proxy holds and that slow backends use up the pool `maxWorkers`, but 5 proxied requests held a worker thread at the backend at once with maxWorkers(2).maxSseStreams(3); the section never names maxSseStreams: - 느린 백엔드는 작업 스레드 풀(`maxWorkers`, 기본 64)을 다 써서 ... - 기본으로는 `maxConcurrent` 한도가 없으므로, 프록시가 잡는 스레드 수를 묶는 것은 `maxWorkers`와 `totalTimeout`입니다.
rows.note: Over TinyHttpd the engine pool is maxWorkers + maxSseStreams (default 64+128=192) and ordinary requests use idle SSE slots, as defaults.md and app.md themselves state; proxy.md and en/proxy.md (lines 351-352) name maxWorkers (default 64) as the pool and the bound. 6 concurrent proxied requests to a holding backend: 5 reached it.

rows.evidence: org.junit.ComparisonFailure: pages without an example of the public ProxyException(kind, cause) constructor, which proxy.md names only in prose (`new ProxyException(kind, cause)`) expected:<[[]]> but was:<[[docs/api java, docs/api kotlin, docs/api/en java, docs/api/en kotlin]]>
rows.note: The public constructor new ProxyException(Kind, Throwable) is stated in a bullet but has no Java or Kotlin example in either language.
TRACE, trace and CONNECT /api/x get 405 with the documented Allow line over TinyHttpd, no backend connection.
No Content-Type added when the backend sends none.
Backend header byte 0xE9 reaches the client as 0xC3 0xA9, as stated.
TinyHttpd keeps received order and case in rawHeaders(); headerNames() lowercase first-seen.
form()/parts() on a JSON request leave the whole body to bodyStream(); a later call after reading is BodyAlreadyConsumedException.
bodyStream() and bodyStream(rawBodyLimit) return the same stream; another limit is IllegalStateException.
A WebSocket upgrade under the proxy mount reaches app.ws (101), backend untouched.
A body drained by an earlier middleware gives 500 without a backend connection.

c005.note: Request.bodyStream/bodyStream(long)/headerNames/rawHeaders/isFromTrustedProxy, RestApp.rawBodyLimit, BodyTooLargeException, Response.append/onAbort/relay and HttpHeaderValues.isFieldValue each have an Express counterpart and Java and Kotlin examples in ko and en; Proxy and ProxyException have Express counterparts, but six Proxy options and the ProxyException constructor have no Java/Kotlin example (LP-2, LP-3).
